info.title: CraftControl API
info.description: Same-origin API for CraftControl. Authentication uses an HttpOnly session cookie. Every non-safe authenticated request also requires the session-bound X-CSRF-Token returned by /api/auth/me. Swagger UI obtains that token for Try it out requests; backend capabilities remain authoritative.
